subject: Office hours check-in: SDK onboarding & API key walk-through

Hi Alex,

Thanks for signing up for the trial — I booked a 45-minute office hours slot so we can walk through SDK setup, exchange API keys in a safe way, and validate a test call from your environment. Details below: 

- When: Tue, Oct 5 · 10:00–10:45 AM PST
- Where: Google Meet link (calendar invite sent)
- Agenda: 1) SDK install (Python + Node examples), 2) test call + KV cache check, 3) quick perf baseline and next steps

I attached a short preflight checklist to help you pull logs and confirm network egress rules before the call — saves time. If you want us to focus on auth/key rotation instead of the SDK, reply and I’ll prioritize that.

Attachments: preflight-integration-checklist.pdf

Best,

Hi Alex / Samira,

I waited on the meet for about 15 minutes but didn’t see anyone join — no worries, these things happen. I wanted to check whether you still want to rebook a 30–45 minute slot this week. 

Options I have open:
- Tue Oct 6: 09:00–09:45 PT
- Wed Oct 7: 13:00–13:45 PT
- Thu Oct 8: 11:00–11:30 PT (short 30-min troubleshooting slot)

If you prefer, I can do a quick 15-minute standby right now to triage a failing test call if you’re available — just reply and I’ll drop a meeting link.

Short notes from our end:
- We attempted an SDK test call using our dev environment and saw a 403 with "invalid API key". No other errors in the app.
- Request ID we saw: rb-6f7c9a2c
- I attached the raw logs extract for the failed call (client-logs-20261005.txt).

I can do the Wed Oct 7 afternoon slot you suggested (13:00 PT) or Thu morning. If possible, we’d like to also cover API key rotation and how to generate scoped keys for test vs prod. If you can share a short checklist for key rotation beforehand, that’d be great.

Thanks,
Alex

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick check-in — we missed the office hours slot

Thanks Alex — no problem at all, Wed Oct 7 at 13:00 PT works for me. I’ve put a new invite on the calendar (45 min) and included a short Google Meet link.

What I’ll do before the call:
- Review the attached logs (thanks for sending) and surface the rb-6f7c9a2c request path.
- Prepare a short demo of scoped API keys and a safe rotation flow (we won’t share secrets in email).
- Bring Monica so we can quickly answer any billing or quota questions.

Quick troubleshooting steps you can try now (if you want to save time on Wed):
1) Confirm you’re calling the trial endpoint: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/trial/generate
2) Double-check that the SDK env var is set (REDWOOD_API_KEY) and not the prod key by mistake.
3) Run the test with verbose logging: REDWOOD_DEBUG=1 node test-call.js (or export REDWOOD_DEBUG=1 && python test_call.py)

I also attached a short key-rotation-checklist that walks through creating scoped keys from the Console, setting expiration, and assigning minimal scopes for test traffic.

If you want that 15-minute standby now, say the word and I’ll drop the meet. Otherwise see you Wed at 13:00 PT.

Best,
Karthik

Attachments: key-rotation-checklist.pdf
